newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New NZ govt July 2009 bonds auctioned at 6.825 pct.
newsitem.headline: New NZ govt July 2009 bonds auctioned at 6.825 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand said on Thursday its offer of NZ$150 million of its new long bond, July 2009 bonds, yielded an average 6.825 percent.
Bids totalled NZ$976 million and there were three successful bidders.
The bonds have a seven percent coupon and settlement is due on July 15.
In the same tender, its offer of NZ$150 million of February 2001 bonds yielded an average 6.73 percent against 7.026 percent for the same maturity in a tender on June 12.
Bids totalled NZ$765 million and there were two successful bidders. The bonds have an eight percent coupon.
